data.description: Regeneration (Ex) No form of attack can suppress a behemoth's regeneration-it regenerates even if disintegrated or slain by a death effect. If a behemoth fails a save against an effect that would kill it instantly, it rises from death 3 rounds later with 1 hit point if no further damage is dealt to its remains. It can be banished or otherwise transported away as a means to save a region, but the only way to truly kill a behemoth is to use miracle or wish to negate its regeneration (see below). &nl; Regeneration (Ex) No form of attack can suppress a behemoth's regeneration-it regenerates even if disintegrated or slain by a death effect.
